author: Nekomusha
quote: The players themselves are the real reviewers, not those political so called critics praising everything to the skies. This game is a woke piece of ****, a straight-up cuckold simulator, and has nothing to do with GTA as the franchise has shown it for decades. Pure scam and corruption for the money you pay, while the critic reviews try to sell you a masterpiece. High scores mean nothing when you're served a mess like this.
